verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents `tofu import` for importing existing resources into state, and community evidence confirms `for_each` support for import blocks (bulk import). However, evidence does not show automatic configuration-code generation from imported resources (e.g., a `-generate-config-out` style feature) — missing for 10: documentation/proof of automatic config generation during import, hands-on demonstration of the full import-to-config workflow, and independent verification of accuracy for generated code.
